title.zh: 法律职业法修正第 2 号命令 2006(1)
title.en: LEGAL PROFESSION ACT AMENDMENT NO. 2 ORDER 2006(1)

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-21_2006_E-LEGAL-PROFESSION-ACT-AMENDMENT-NO.-2-ORDER-2006(1).pdf》（2 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Legal Profession Act (Amendment) (No. 2) of section 3 of Chapter 132.

Section 3 of the Legal Profession Act is amended - {a) in subsection (1) -

(i) in paragraph (b), by deleting "or" from the last line;

(ii) in paragraph {c), by deleting the fullstop and by substituting "; or"

(iii) by adding the following new paragraph - "(d) is a barrister, solicitor or who is a barrister and solicitor of a Supreme Court of any Australian State or Territory.";

(b) in subsection (3), by inserting ", in any Australian State or Territory" immediately after "Malaysia" in the eight line. Made this 23rd. day of Muharam, 1427 Hijriah corresponding to the 22nd. day of February, 2006 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI PERTUAN

DARUSSALAM
